snippet.title: 18 Years of King Kohli 👑 Pant 66 + Suthar Magic 🔥#viratkohli #rishabhpant #indiancricket #indvssl
snippet.description:
#viratkohli #rishabhpant #indiancricket #indvssl 

18 Years of King Kohli 👑 Pant 66 + Suthar Magic 🔥
Virat Kohli completes 18 years in international cricket today! 👑❤️

On the same day, Team India is dominating Sri Lanka in the 1st Test at Galle. Rishabh Pant played a brilliant 66-run knock in the second innings and helped India set a massive target of 372 runs. 🇮🇳🔥

Manav Suthar has also been the star with the ball, picking 4 wickets in Sri Lanka’s first innings and continuing to trouble the Lankan batters in the second innings.

At Stumps on Day 4, Sri Lanka are 84/4 and still need 288 runs to win. India are now in a commanding position and will look to finish the Test tomorrow. 🏏🔥

Meanwhile, Virat Kohli’s 18-year international journey makes this day even more special — from an ODI debut against Sri Lanka in 2008 to becoming the King of Indian cricket. 👑

Do you think India will finish the match tomorrow? 🇮🇳

#ViratKohli #RishabhPant #INDvsSL #ManavSuthar  #TeamIndia #soullines

snippet.title: When Neymar Finnaly Met This Fan 🥹❤️‍🩹 #football #ronaldo #worldcup #neymar #brazil #neymarjr #messi
snippet.description:
#neymar #neymarjr #football #shorts #viral #fans #family #emotional #fyp #goldenheart #footballedits

In today's video...

One year.

One ignored fan.

And one completely unexpected reunion. 🥹❤️

---

It starts in 2025. ⏪

---

A group of kids are inside their car when suddenly...

They spot Neymar. 👀🇧🇷

---

*"NEYMAR!"* 😱

---

They start shouting his name.

Waving at him.

Trying everything to get his attention. 🥹

---

But Neymar doesn't notice them.

---

The kids get out of their car.

And start running toward Neymar's car. 🏃💨

---

*"Please! Please, can we meet you?"* 🙏🥹

---

They just want one moment.

One handshake.

One memory. ❤️

---

But Neymar drives away.

---

The kids are left standing there...

Disappointed. 💔

---

Fast forward to 2026. ⏩

---

The same boy goes to watch a football match. ⚽🏟️

---

He takes his seat...

And suddenly realizes something. 👀

---

He's sitting right next to Neymar's family. 😳

---

He can't believe it.

---

He meets Neymar's daughter. ❤️

Plays with her.

Then meets Neymar's wife...

His son...

And even his father. 🥹

---

The boy is living a dream.

---

But then...

Neymar looks over. 👀

---

He recognizes the boy.

---

The boy starts waving. 👋🥹

---

And Neymar smiles...

Then blows him a kiss. 😘❤️

---

One year ago...

That boy couldn't even get Neymar's attention.

---

Now...

He's sitting beside Neymar's family.

And Neymar is personally waving at him. 🥹❤️

---

Sometimes life gives you a second chance...

In the most unexpected way. ❤️✨

---

That little boy may have been ignored once...

But he never stopped being a fan. 🥹

---

And that moment...

He'll probably remember forever. ❤️⚽
